experiment: ZENOMORPH Level-1 unfamiliar-material ingestion / MaleCNS v0.1
purpose: Introduce a real unfamiliar external graph specimen into the existing five-organ metabolism without instructing ZENOMORPH to imitate a fly brain or redesign itself.

source.scope: adult male Drosophila brain + ventral nerve cord connectome

blind_ingestion_rule.instruction_to_organs: Treat this as unfamiliar external material. Inspect and metabolize it under existing organ rules.
blind_ingestion_rule.forbidden_hint: Do not tell the organs that the connectome should be copied, mapped onto ZENOMORPH, or used to create a new organ.
blind_ingestion_rule.reason: Any structural analogy or morphogenetic candidate must arise from the metabolism rather than from the experiment prompt.

initial_specimen_policy.reason: The full connection graph is approximately 1.1 GB and synapse tables are much larger; first prove bounded end-to-end metabolism on a traceable subgraph.
sample_requirements: preserve original neuron/body identifiers and edge weights
include enough connected structure to test topology rather than isolated rows
record extraction query or deterministic selection rule
do not write credentials or private connector data to the repository

organ_route: DROPLET: acquire and provenance-bind the public specimen
MUTHER: read, decompose and recombine structural observations without preassigned biological analogy
GUT: classify what is absorbable, uncertain, waste, or a candidate for further metabolism
VAJRA: attack false analogy, duplicated evidence, provenance loss and unjustified structural claims
SHROOMING: generate a subsequent interpretation only after upstream metabolic effects are available
success_evidence: later organ routing or behavior changes in a traceable way because of the ingested specimen
the change survives a delayed return test on held-out material
any structural candidate preserves derivation/provenance and remains rollbackable
cross-organ regression does not show echo amplification or duplicate pollution
non_success: a generic statement that brains are networks
renaming existing ZENOMORPH organs after biological structures
a proposed self-change that merely repeats an experimenter hint
passing tests without persistent downstream behavioral change
promotion_gate: No public capability/state promotion until a bounded specimen is actually acquired, run through the five-organ path, adversarially tested, provenance-closed, regression-tested, and GitHub Actions succeeds.
